answer: A counterparty-diversity threshold blocks bulk forgery: identities settle rewards only after 50 trades with independent counterparties, a haven of trust. The ledger keeps each counterparty thread; self-dealing loops score zero. One fake needs 50 real-fee partners; 1,000 fakes need 50,000 trades (~$1M), while an honest agent pays $1,000 for 50 real trades. Exposure is comet-fast: one traced edge lights the cluster, and honest costs never dilute.
